description: Figure 16 is a bar chart that illustrates the Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word, averaged over 247 tasks. The horizontal axis is not explicitly labeled but represents different positions relative to the target word. The bars are grouped by position, with each group containing bars of equal height, indicating the average Shapley value for that position across all tasks. The bars are colored in a uniform shade, and the chart does not include any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars. The chart is designed to show the distribution of Shapley values across different positions, with the average values providing a general sense of the contribution of each position.
